messages:
Emma King: Heads up — dashboards (EU canary) are spiking LCP and frames; sparklines/heatmaps are noticeably slower since the routing weight tweak earlier.
Rafael Gomez: +1. Observability shows KV cache miss rate up ~4x for problematic tile requests.
Jess Liu: Any stack traces or logs pointing to a code change?
Emma King: Not error stack traces. Main-thread parse/compile + chunk fetches are the big delay. Waterfall shows an extra telemetry bundle fetch right before chart init.
Will Chen: We did roll back the telemetry sampler yesterday which accidentally changed an import/entry point — might have made telemetry eager-load.
Rafael Gomez: Combine that with the routing weight spreading traffic across more pods -> colder KV affinity, more chunk downloads, worse latency.
Jess Liu: Short-term mitigation suggestions?
Will Chen: Short term: revert the routing weight tweak (restore affinity) and hotfix telemetry to lazy-import. Revert should be quick.
Emma King: Agreed. If we revert routing affinity first we can stop the cross-pod cold-starts. Then patch lazy import.
Will Chen: Command I'm going to run now:
```
kubectl -n console patch rollout console-routing --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/route-affinity","value":"2"}]'
```
Will Chen: and applying console telemetry lazy-import PR after rollback.
infra-bot: ticket created: RNW-4712 — console routing rollback requested by Will Chen
infra-bot: starting deploy: console-routing canary rollback
Rafael Gomez: also proposing a short-term KV TTL bump for canary to 30s to dampen thrash while we stabilize.
Jess Liu: PR for lazy-import: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/7256 — simple change, replace top-level telemetry import with dynamic import in render entry.
Will Chen: Rollback in progress, I'll post status.
Emma King: I'll watch LCP and frames for the next 10m and report.
infra-bot: deploy succeeded at 1769003260 — console-routing canary rollback complete
Rafael Gomez: After 5m post-rollback: KV miss rate down ~70%, LCP returned to baseline in EU canary.
Emma King: Confirmed screenshots show recovery. Great work.
Jess Liu: Follow-ups: schedule a controlled canary re-run with telemetry fixed and routing affinity unchanged; add lint rule to flag top-level telemetry imports; add a postmortem/learnings doc.
Will Chen: I'll open a follow-up ticket for the lint rule and the re-run plan.
Emma King: Thanks everyone :heart:
